system.description:
You quickly defend yourself with your weapon to soften the blow. Reduce the damage you would take by an amount equal to your [Weapons damage]. Do not add any jutsu based bonuses to damage, to the result.

Chain 1: You maintain the damage reduction effect until the beginning of your next turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage reduced by 2. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, if there is a solid structure within your Weapons range, after the triggering damage, you can move within 5 feet of the select structure, as your pull yourself out of the range of further attacks.
